h: Hearing the Word of Hashem Restores the Heart Through Teshuvah

p: and the three haftaros of retribution
correspond to the three upper ones;
that they did not want to listen
And in the Pesikta (the new Pesikta d'Rav Kahana)
their Midrash on this is cited
a parable of a king," etc.;
And certainly the meaning is not
that they should be careful with hearing alone
without fulfilling it in deed, chas v'shalom;
for then his punishment is more severe
than if he had not learned at all
(as they said, Midrash Rabbah Ki Savo).
But the main intent of hearing
is that it enter the heart;
and then it is called hearing.
and the whole body receives life," etc.;
like the rack to the vessels," etc.
"Above all that you guard, guard your heart,
for from it are the issues of life."
And it is as we said,
שֶׁמַּה שֶּׁדָּרַשׁ דְּבַר ה׳ עַל הַשַּׁבָּת
that the expounding of "the word of Hashem" as Shabbos
is that on Shabbos a person has the power
that will be the word of Hashem;
כֵּן יִהְיֶה דְבָרִי אֲשֶׁר יֵצֵא מִפִּי
"So shall My word be that goes out of My mouth;
it shall not return to Me empty";
that it will enter the heart.
they put "we will do" before "we will hear";
that is, they were bound to Hashem Yisbarach
so that they had no desire at all
whatever would be the will of Hashem Yisbarach,
and they did not need hearing first.
He said to them, "be careful with 'we will hear'":
and it will enter the heart,
וְעַל יְדֵי זֶה יְקַיְּימוּ אַחַר כָּךְ
and through that they will fulfill it afterward.
"Hear the word of Hashem, House of Yaakov"
"'And to the House of Yaakov their sins' (Yeshayahu 58:1)
for whom willful sins are made like errors."
that on Shabbos even the laborers,
who are busy all the weekdays
for engaging in words of Torah,
as they said (Yerushalmi, perek 15 of Shabbos).
And it says in the Pesikta,
that the opinion "to engage in Torah"
and as they said in Tanna d'Vei Eliyahu
אַף עַל פִּי שֶׁאַתֶּם עוֹשִׂים מְלָאכָה
Shabbos should be made entirely Torah," etc.
"And all the families of the House of Israel"
עַל דֶּרֶךְ מַה שֶּׁאָמְרוּ (מְגִילָּה ג, א)
along the lines of what they said (Megillah 3a):
to include the families of Kohanim and Levi'im," etc.;
for the prophet rebuked them all,

p: וְאָמַר הַנָּבִיא אַחַר כָּךְ (יִרְמְיָה ב, ח)
"The Kohanim did not say, Where is Hashem?"
although they are occupied with the avodah,
"They shall teach Your judgments to Yaakov," etc.,
וּבָאתָ אֶל הַכֹּהֲנִים הַלְוִיִּם וְגוֹ׳ (שָׁם יז, ט)
and "You shall come to the Kohanim, the Levi'im," etc. (Devarim 17:9)
yet they did not say "Where is Hashem?":
that they should search and investigate
that they engage in Torah lishmah,
and recognize the power of the Giver of the Torah;
that they perform it for the sake of Heaven,
מִפְּנֵי צִיוּוּיוֹ שֶׁל הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא
because of the command of HaKadosh Baruch Hu,
to do only His will, blessed be His Name;
the light of Torah in every mitzvah.
that it says in the Gemara (Sotah 21a):
that a lamp shines only for a time,
is like a lamp without light.
And we said that in every mitzvah,
the intent for the sake of Heaven in the mitzvah
but it is a particular lamp
and this shines only for a time.
And so with words of Torah:
when he does not learn lishmah,
and it is a lamp and wick
with the intent for the sake of Heaven,
to look to the Giver of the Torah,
that is the light from the Torah,
and it is the general light,
(and this has been explained many times).
And this is what it says, "The Kohanim":
they did not say "Where is Hashem?"
of the Torah and the Commander of the mitzvos,
who have already taken hold of the Torah,
along the lines of what is called
in the holy Zohar (beginning of Parshas Korach):
holds on to the Tree of Life;
once he holds on to it,
he holds on to everything," etc.
that is, the words of Torah did not enter
into the depths of the heart,
"Then you will understand the fear of Hashem
and find the knowledge of God";
that is, then he is bound to the root.
It is like what is said of the Avos (Shemos 6:3):
"But by My Name Havayah I was not known";
the Name Havayah is mentioned many times.
is the aspect of the Written Torah;
regarding the blessing before the Torah,
"When I call the Name of Hashem," etc.
only from what they understood from creation;
for the whole world is words of Torah
לֹא נִבְרָא אֶלָּא בִּשְׁבִיל זֶה וְכוּלֵּי
was created only for the sake of this," etc.,
"only to be a companion to this";
and why did he need the whole world?
בְּשֵׁם הָרַבִּי רַבִּי בּוּנִם זֵכֶר צַדִּיק לִבְרָכָה
in the name of the Rebbe, Rabbi Bunim, zt"l:
for man to recognize from it
the glory and Kingship of Heaven,
and this is the meaning of "as El Shaddai."
that is, the revelation of the Name Havayah,
was not revealed until Mattan Torah;
and this is "I was not known to them."
And so the prophet says here
that even "those who grasp the Torah,"
who seem already to have taken hold of the Torah,
which is called "holding on to the Torah,"
that it be bound in the depths of the heart.
"the families of the House of Israel."

p: that when Rosh Chodesh Av falls on Shabbos,
כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב (רַמָ״א אוֹרַח חַיִּים סִימָן תכה)
as is written (Rema, Orach Chaim, siman 425),
that this is the main practice
וְהִנֵּה כְּשֶׁחָל רֹאשׁ חוֹדֶשׁ אֱלוּל בְּשַׁבָּת
Now when Rosh Chodesh Elul falls on Shabbos,
But according to what was said,
has something of the matter of the haftarah "Shim'u";
and this is of the matter of hearing,
to rectify the aspect of hearing,
as was expounded on the passage "Shim'u."
which is expounded about all the groups of Yisrael;
just as it says in the prophecy "Shim'u,"
That is, to rectify what was said:
"The Kohanim did not say, Where is Hashem,
and those who grasp the Torah did not know Me,"
And the beginning of the passage,
"And where is the place of My rest?"
is expounded about the day of Shabbos;
"But to this one will I look:
to the poor and contrite of spirit
which is cited at the beginning of Seder Eliyahu Rabbah
when a person takes to heart
he becomes poor and contrite of spirit
for Shabbos is a time of teshuvah,
"It is good to give thanks to Hashem";
"He who confesses and forsakes shall find mercy";
is in the aspect of a talmid chacham,
for Shabbos should be made entirely Torah;
which is expounded about talmidei chachamim.
when there is the revelation of Atika,
"The alef bored through in the darkness," etc.,
which is hidden from all thought;
and then the baal teshuvah can merit
that his willful sins become like merits,
since they are bound at the root to Hashem Yisbarach;
as in the conclusion of the haftarah "Shim'u":
"You are the Master of my youth,"
